spans.s:
1 दम् दा॑म्यति pp. दान्त॑ (q.v.) be or make tame;
conquer, master, control. C. दम॑यति = S. tr.
2 द॑म् s. (only ˚— & gen. pl. दमा॑म्) = seq.
1 द॑म m. or n. house, home.
दाम n. आ॑ f. = 3 दा॑मन्.
दमक a. (—˚) = prec. a.
दमघोष m. N. of a prince.
दमदान n. du. self-control and liberality.
दमनक m. N. of a man & a jackal.
दममय a. consisting of self-control.
दमयन्ती f. N. of the wife of Nala.
दमयितृ m. tamer, subduer, chastiser.
दमाय् दमा˚य॑ति subdue or control (also one's self).
दमितृ॑ m. tamer, subduer.

दमिन् a. tamed;
 controlling one's self.
दमोपेत a. endowed with self-control.
दम्भ m. deceit, fraud, hypocrisy.
दम्भक a. deceiving, deluding (—˚).
†दम्भन a. (—˚) & n. harming, deceiving.
दम्भिन् a. deceitful, m. deceiver, hypocrite.
दम्भोलि m. Indra's thunderbolt.
दम्भोलिपाणि m. E. of Indra (cf. prec.).
2 द॑म्य a. being in a house, homely.
1 दाम॑न् m. giver, a liberal man.

2 दा॑मन् n. gift, donation;
 p. ˚न्वन्त्.
3 दाम॑न् m. or f. allotment, share.
दामोदरगुप्त m. names of poets.
दामोदर˚मिश्र m. names of poets.

दाम्भिक a. deceitful;
 m. cheat, hypocrite.
